prompt: Copper paints the fence bright yellow
title: Bright Yellow Fence
irony: Copper paints the fence bright yellow for tomorrow's buyers, but it only shines when today's friends stop to share it.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning light finds Copper's gray wobbly fence as Green counts slats and Navy waves from the sidewalk.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants a smooth perfect yellow fence and recites paint facts while Copper rushes in late dreaming of next year.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Copper brushes the first bright yellow streak and Black dares the kids to paint fast before lunch.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street chants and paints together as yellow spreads across the old gray fence.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The yellow glows too bright and drips everywhere as Jade rushes ahead and Green freezes with the brush.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Everyone squints at the blazing fence behind hands while Yellow calls the glare like a grand final.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew keeps chanting and painting as the bright yellow fence shines down the street.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Alone at the fence, Copper holds the brush and thinks about selling next year versus smiling today.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Copper chooses today and invites the kids to share the brush while Green nods with room for all.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: All paint the last slat together as Copper sings the fence shines brightest with friends beside it.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: All chant by the finished yellow fence in morning light as neighbors stop to smile and stay.
